needed.evidence: Informal path less than 1m wide, often obstructed and tripping hazards
needed.suggestion: Construct a formal pedestrian footway at least 1m wide along the left side to provide a safe walking space.

needed.evidence: Obstructions like parked vehicles and market stalls on the path
needed.suggestion: Ensure the right-side informal walking path is kept clear of obstructions for pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: Broken, uneven sections on the informal path
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the broken sections on the left informal path to eliminate tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven surfaces hindering pedestrian movement
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections on the right informal path to ensure safe walking.

needed.evidence: No crossing facilities provided despite crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install marked zebra crossings at key locations along the road to facilitate safe pedestrian crossing.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting along the road at nighttime conditions
